query: What sample size and power are needed to detect small-to-moderate effects of populist frames on purchase intent in surveys/field experiments?

response.query: What sample size and power are needed to detect small-to-moderate effects of populist frames on purchase intent in surveys/field experiments?
response.answer: To detect small-to-moderate effects of populist frames on purchase intent, a sample size of around 200-300 participants and a power of 80% (0.80) is generally recommended. Larger sample sizes may be needed for more precise effect size detection.
